items.exampleEn: Scientists can now change plants genetically.
items.exampleZh: 科學家現在可以從基因上改變植物。

items.exampleEn: The singer became deaf in one ear.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手一隻耳朵失聰了。

items.exampleEn: Sickness kept him away from school for a week.
items.exampleZh: 他因為生病一個星期沒去上學。

items.exampleEn: The medicine comes in small capsules.
We bathe the dog once a month.
items.exampleZh: 我們每個月幫狗洗一次澡。

items.exampleEn: An ache in my tooth woke me up at night.
items.exampleZh: 牙齒一陣疼痛讓我半夜醒來。

items.exampleEn: Aspirin was first made more than a hundred years ago.
items.exampleZh: 阿斯匹靈是一百多年前首次製造出來的。

items.sentenceEn: This box of aspirin costs about three dollars.
items.sentenceZh: 這盒阿斯匹靈大約三元。

items.audioEn: The time capsule will be opened in twenty years, when the students are adults.
items.audioZh: 這個時空膠囊二十年後會打開，那時學生們都長大了。
items.questionZh: 時空膠囊什麼時候會打開？

items.sentenceEn: The smell of the sea makes me want to inhale deeply.
items.sentenceZh: 海的味道讓我想深深吸一口氣。

items.sentenceEn: The children bathed in the river on hot afternoons.
items.sentenceZh: 天氣熱的下午，孩子們在河裡洗澡。

items.stemEn: Long bus rides always give me travel ____.
items.stemZh: 長途搭公車總讓我暈車。

items.stemEn: The two plants look the same, but they are ____ different.
items.stemZh: 這兩種植物看起來一樣，但在基因上不同。

items.passageEn: Every summer, our family stays at a small resort by a lake. My little brother suffers from car sickness, so we stop often on the drive. At the resort, my mother likes to bathe in the warm spring water, and she says it helps her relax after the long drive. My grandfather is deaf, but he talks with us using his hands and a small notebook. On the last night, we put letters in a time capsule and buried it under a tree. We plan to open it in ten years.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，我們全家都會住在湖邊的一個小度假村。我弟弟會暈車，所以路上我們常常停下來。在度假村，媽媽喜歡泡溫暖的泉水，她說這能讓她在長途開車後放鬆。我爺爺聽不見，但他用手和一本小筆記本和我們溝通。最後一晚，我們把信放進時空膠囊，埋在一棵樹下。我們打算十年後打開。

questions.questionZh: 他們在時空膠囊裡放了什麼？

items.promptZh: 爬山之後我的腿很痠痛。
referenceEn: I had an ache in my legs after the hike.
After climbing the mountain, I had an ache in my legs.
rubricZh: ache 表示「疼痛」，例如 an ache in my legs、my legs ached 等說法
「爬山」可寫，例如 the hike、climbing the mountain 等
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 sickness 造一個句子，說說你或家人搭車、搭船時不舒服的經驗。
referenceEn: I get car sickness when I read in the car.
My father gets travel sickness on small boats.
rubricZh: sickness 表示「（暈車、暈船等的）不適」，例如 car sickness、travel sickness 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
